name: User
description: User account information for employees, managers, and HR personnel

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for login and communication

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: User's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: User's last name

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role: employee, manager, or hr

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

name: Role
description: User roles defining access levels and permissions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the role

fields.name: name
fields.description: Role name (e.g., Admin, Manager, User)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the role's purpose

fields.name: permissions
fields.description: List of permission strings granted to this role

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the role is currently active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the role was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the role was last updated

relationships.description: Users assigned to this role

name: LeaveRequest
description: Employee leave request with approval tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave request

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the employee requesting leave

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date of the leave period

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: End date of the leave period

fields.name: leaveType
fields.description: Type of leave (vacation, sick, personal, etc.)

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Reason or description for the leave request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Approval status (pending, approved, rejected)

fields.name: approvedBy
fields.description: Reference to the user who approved/rejected the request

relationships.description: Employee who submitted the leave request
Manager who approved or rejected the request

name: LeaveType
description: Types of leave available to employees

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave type

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the leave type (e.g., Annual Leave, Sick Leave)

fields.name: code
fields.description: Short code for the leave type (e.g., AL, SL, ML)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the leave type

fields.name: defaultDaysAllowed
fields.description: Default number of days allowed per year for this leave type

fields.name: requiresApproval
fields.description: Whether this leave type requires manager approval

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this leave type is currently active and available

name: EmergencyContact
description: Emergency contact information for leave requests

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the emergency contact

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who owns this emergency contact

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the emergency contact person

fields.name: relationship
fields.description: Relationship to the user (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling)

fields.name: phoneNumber
fields.description: Primary phone number to reach the emergency contact

fields.name: alternatePhoneNumber
fields.description: Secondary phone number for the emergency contact

fields.name: isPrimary
fields.description: Indicates if this is the primary emergency contact

relationships.description: Each emergency contact belongs to one user

constraints.uniquePrimaryPerUser: Only one emergency contact can be marked as primary per user

name: LeaveType
description: Master data for different types of leaves available in the organization

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave type

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the leave type (e.g., Annual Leave, Sick Leave, Maternity Leave)

fields.name: code
fields.description: Short code for the leave type (e.g., AL, SL, ML)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the leave type and its usage

fields.name: defaultDaysAllowed
fields.description: Default number of days allowed per year for this leave type

fields.name: requiresApproval
fields.description: Whether this leave type requires manager approval

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this leave type is currently active and available for use

name: Approval
description: Tracks approval records for leave requests

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the approval record

fields.name: leaveRequestId
fields.description: Reference to the leave request being approved

fields.name: approverId
fields.description: Reference to the user who approved or rejected the request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Approval status (pending, approved, rejected)

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Optional comments or notes from the approver

fields.name: approvedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the approval decision was made

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the approval record was created

name: ApprovalLevel
description: Defines approval levels and their configurations for multi-stage approval workflows

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the approval level

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the approval level (e.g., Manager, Director, HR)

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Order in which this level should be processed (1, 2, 3, etc.)

fields.name: roleId
fields.description: Reference to the Role that can approve at this level

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this approval level is currently active

fields.name: autoApproveThreshold
fields.description: Optional threshold (e.g., days) below which auto-approval may occur

fields.name: isFinal
fields.description: Indicates if this is the final approval level in the workflow

relationships.description: Links approval level to a specific role

constraints.uniqueSequence: Sequence numbers should be unique within an approval workflow
constraints.positiveSequence: Sequence must be a positive integer

name: LeaveCalendar
description: Calendar view representation of leave requests

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the calendar entry

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user whose leave is displayed

fields.name: leaveRequestId
fields.description: Reference to the associated leave request

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date of the leave period

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: End date of the leave period

fields.name: leaveTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of leave

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the leave request (pending, approved, rejected)

fields.name: displayColor
fields.description: Color code for calendar visualization

constraints.endDateAfterStartDate: endDate must be greater than or equal to startDate
constraints.validStatus: status must be one of: pending, approved, rejected, cancelled

name: ConflictRule
description: Rules for detecting and preventing leave conflicts

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the conflict rule

fields.name: ruleName
fields.description: Name of the conflict rule

fields.name: ruleType
fields.description: Type of conflict (e.g., TEAM_OVERLAP, ROLE_COVERAGE, MAX_CONCURRENT)

fields.name: maxConcurrentLeaves
fields.description: Maximum number of concurrent leaves allowed

fields.name: targetScope
fields.description: Scope of the rule (e.g., DEPARTMENT, TEAM, ROLE, ORGANIZATION)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the rule is currently active

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level for rule evaluation (higher number = higher priority)

name: Notification
description: Stores notification records to be sent to users

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the user to receive the notification

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of notification (email, sms, push, in-app)

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Subject or title of the notification

fields.name: message
fields.description: Content body of the notification

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status (pending, sent, failed, read)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was created

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was sent

relationships.description: Notification belongs to a user

name: NotificationTemplate
description: Email templates for different notification types

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification template

fields.name: templateName
fields.description: Unique name identifying the template type (e.g., LEAVE_APPROVED, LEAVE_REJECTED)

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Email subject line with support for variables (e.g., {{userName}})

fields.name: body
fields.description: Email body content with support for variables and HTML formatting

fields.name: variables
fields.description: Array of available variables for this template (e.g., userName, leaveType, dates)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this template is currently active and can be used

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp of last template modification

name: Department
description: Organizational departments for user grouping and leave management

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the department

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the department

fields.name: code
fields.description: Short code or abbreviation for the department

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: User ID of the department manager

fields.name: description
fields.description: Brief description of the department's function

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the department is currently active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the department was created

relationships.description: Users belonging to this department
Manager of the department

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave allocation

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the employee receiving the allocation

fields.name: leaveTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of leave being allocated

fields.name: allocationYear
fields.description: Year for which the leave is allocated

fields.name: totalDays
fields.description: Total number of leave days allocated

fields.name: usedDays
fields.description: Number of leave days already used

fields.name: remainingDays
fields.description: Number of leave days remaining

Quick lookup of allocations by user

name: LeaveBalanceHistory

fields.name: id

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user whose balance changed

fields.name: leaveTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of leave affected

fields.name: changeAmount
fields.description: Amount of balance change (positive for additions, negative for deductions)

fields.name: balanceAfter
fields.description: Leave balance after this change was applied

fields.name: changeReason
fields.description: Reason for the balance change (e.g., allocation, leave taken, adjustment, expiry)

fields.name: referenceId
fields.description: Reference to related entity (LeaveRequest, LeaveAllocation, etc.)

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the balance change occurred

relationships.description: Balance history belongs to a user
Balance history is associated with a leave type

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the approval history record

fields.name: approvalId
fields.description: Reference to the approval record

fields.name: leaveRequestId
fields.description: Reference to the leave request being approved

fields.name: actorId
fields.description: User ID who performed the approval action

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action taken (approved, rejected, pending, delegated)

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Optional comments or reason for the action

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the action was performed

fields.name: departmentId
fields.description: Reference to the department being tracked

fields.name: date
fields.description: Specific date for availability snapshot

fields.name: totalMembers
fields.description: Total number of team members in the department

fields.name: availableMembers
fields.description: Number of members available (not on leave)

fields.description: Number of members currently on leave

fields.name: availabilityPercentage
fields.description: Percentage of team available (0-100)

description: Audit log of all sent notifications

fields.name: notificationId
fields.description: Reference to the original notification

fields.name: recipientId
fields.description: ID of the user who received the notification

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status (sent, delivered, failed, bounced)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Delivery channel used (email, sms, push, in-app)

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was sent

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.description: Error details if delivery failed

Links to the recipient user

name: UserRole
description: Association between users and their assigned roles

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user-role assignment

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user being assigned a role

fields.name: roleId
fields.description: Reference to the role being assigned

fields.name: assignedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the role was assigned to the user

fields.name: assignedBy
fields.description: Reference to the user who assigned this role

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this role assignment is currently active

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: Optional expiration date for temporary role assignments

relationships.description: The user who has this role
The role assigned to the user
The user who performed the role assignment

indexes.description: Ensures a user cannot have the same role assigned multiple times
Optimizes queries for finding all roles of a user
Optimizes queries for finding all users with a specific role
Optimizes queries for active role assignments

description: Current leave balance tracking for employees

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the employee user

fields.name: leaveTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of leave

fields.name: totalAllocated
fields.description: Total leave days allocated for the period

fields.name: used
fields.description: Number of leave days used

fields.name: available
fields.description: Remaining leave days available

fields.name: year
fields.description: Year for which this balance applies

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.description: Timestamp of last balance update

Each balance is for one leave type

constraints.uniqueBalancePerYear: One balance record per user, leave type, and year combination
